description: FR-370 window aggregate atom (TC-303 step 15): the single aggregate argument of a quire.op.temporal.aggregate application. Each case gives the clause's temporal_profile law identity and the argument; references names the family (and unit) of each expression node a reference term targets; clock_unit is the scalar_type/unit node that every timestamped-event case's clause clock names as its timestamp_unit (ms), so a duration bound of past[0, 300 s] is 0 and 300000 of it. A reader case is its base positive with one mutation: one member replaced, added, removed or moved, or only the profile changed. A reader case's pointer is relative to the application body /semantic_graph/nodes/{n}/body; an empty pointer is the body.
